controls.Triangle: Jump / action / double jump / air hike
controls.Circle: Sword or punch/kick attack / Round Trip

evidence.Default/Start: pdf4 (printed 5) Default Settings Type A: START button - Start game, Display Sub Screen; pdf9 (printed 14): press the START button during gameplay to display the Sub Screen
evidence.Default/Select: pdf4 (printed 5): SELECT button - Skip movie/cut-scenes, Pause and display Pause menu
evidence.Default/Left stick: pdf4 (printed 5): left analog stick - Move Dante/menu cursor; pdf13 (printed 22): move the left analog stick slightly in a direction to walk, all the way to run
evidence.Default/Right stick: pdf4 (printed 5): right analog stick - Toggle Thunder Devil/Fire Devil (after acquiring items)
evidence.Default/Triangle: pdf4 (printed 5): Triangle button - Cancel selection, Jump/Action, Triangle + Triangle buttons = Double jump (off an object), Triangle + Triangle buttons = Air Hike (after acquiring Red Orbs); pdf15 (printed 26): press the Triangle button during a jump to double jump in the air
evidence.Default/Circle: pdf4 (printed 5): Circle button - Sword or punch/kick attack; Circle button (hold) = Round Trip (after acquiring Red Orbs)
evidence.Default/Cross: pdf4 (printed 5): X button - Confirm selection, Check; pdf13 (printed 22): move Dante in front of an item and press the X or Square button
evidence.Default/Square: pdf4 (printed 5): Square button - Same as X button; pdf13 (printed 22): press the X or Square button
evidence.Default/R1+Cross/R1+Square: pdf4 (printed 5): R1 (hold) + X buttons = Gun attack; Square button - Same as X button; pdf13 (printed 23): hold down the R1 button and press the X or Square button to fire your gun
evidence.Default/Triangle+R1+Cross/Triangle+R1+Sq: pdf4 (printed 5): Triangle + R1 (hold) + X buttons = Air Raid (as Alastor); pdf15 (printed 26): Jump, then press the R1 button + the X or Square button
evidence.Default/Left stick+R1+Triangle: pdf4 (printed 5): Left/Right arrows + R1 (hold) + Triangle buttons = Rolling dodge; pdf13 (printed 22): with R1 held down, move the left analog stick toward Dante's side and press Triangle (Rolling Dodge); toward Dante's front or back and press Triangle (Somersault)
evidence.Default/Left stick+R1+Circle: pdf13 (printed 23): hold down R1, move the left analog stick away from the direction Dante is facing and press Circle (High Time); pdf15 (printed 26): left analog stick in the direction Dante is facing, hold R1 and press Circle (Stinger)
evidence.Default/L1: pdf4 (printed 5): L1 button - Devil Trigger (see page 24), Turn pages in Sub Screen; pdf14 (printed 24): press the L1 button to perform the Devil Trigger; cancel by pressing the L1 button
evidence.Default/R1: pdf4 (printed 5): R1 button - Turn pages in Sub Screen, (hold) Lock on nearest enemy; pdf13 (printed 23): press and hold the R1 button, Dante will target the nearest enemy
